item.description:
Changed

  • Updates are found within the hour. The app checks for a new version at launch and then every hour, instead of about once a day, and no longer asks first whether to check automatically. Turn it off in Settings. Copies already on 0.6.1 or earlier keep the slower checks until they take this update.
  • Permissions stay granted across updates. Builds are now signed with a stable identity, so macOS stops asking again for system audio, calendar and camera after every update. Each person is asked once more on this update, then not again.
  • Download and GitHub links point at this fork, not the original project. The README drops the Homebrew command and the original's star chart, and lists Apple Silicon only.
